assets.name: road

The photo will be cropped into a very wide banner, so keep important scenic features in the central horizontal band. Medium: natural editorial travel photography, subtle warm light, real road texture, restrained colors, fine natural detail. Mood: calm, inviting, open, reliable. No people, no cars close to camera, no fictional landmarks, no road signs, no buildings, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no graphic elements, no UI. This is a decorative landscape inspired by Angola, not a documentary image of a specific named place.
